an6.43:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.43:1.2: atha kho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
an6.43:1.3: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an6.43:1.4: āyāmānanda yena pubbārāmo migāramātupāsādo tenupasaṅkamissāma divā vihārāyāti.
an6.43:1.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.43:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbārāmo migāramātupāsādo tenupasaṅkami
an6.43:2.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi
an6.43:2.3: āyāmānanda yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkamissāma gattāni parisiñcitunti.
an6.43:2.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
an6.43:2.5: atha kho bhagavā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ yena pubbakoṭṭhako tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ
an6.43:2.6: pubbakoṭṭhake gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbasadisāni kurumāno.
an6.43:3.1: tena kho pana samayena rañño passenadissa kosalassa seto nāma nāgo mahāturiyatāḷitavāditena pubbakoṭṭhakā paccuttarati.
an6.43:3.3: abhirūpo vata bho rañño nāgo dassanīyo vata bho rañño nāgo pāsādiko vata bho rañño nāgo kāyupapanno vata bho rañño nāgoti.
an6.43:3.4: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an6.43:3.5: hatthimeva nu kho bhante mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha
an6.43:3.6: nāgo vata bho nāgoti udāhu aññampi kañci mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha nāgo vata bho nāgoti
an6.43:3.7: hatthimpi kho udāyi mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha
an6.43:3.13: manussampi kho udāyi mahantaṃ brahantaṃ kāyupapannaṃ jano disvā evamāha
an6.43:3.15: api cudāyi yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā tamahaṃ nāgoti brūmīti.
an6.43:4.3: api cudāyi yo sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya āguṃ na karoti kāyena vācāya manasā tamahaṃ nāgoti brūmīti.
an6.43:4.4: idañca panāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā subhāsitaṃ imāhi gāthāhi anumodāmi
